title: 第一卷 第344章 他一直在勾引你第一卷 第343章 你都不摸摸我你都不叫我小龙了
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
有些地方战斗一触即发，有些地方的人正在享受。
舒晩昭守在入口等待很久，没有等到外来者，就继续她的下午茶。
反正有大师兄在，大师兄那么厉害，那三个男人在一起，应该不会有事的。
【……】
人生最后的一段时光，若是天天这么惬意就好了。
还是大师兄心细，懂她。
甜滋滋的水果口中吃，仰头是郁郁葱葱的树木，空气也很清新，还夹杂着刚刚大师兄的草药味，刚刚她在大师兄的果盘旁边找到了一个小瓶子，打开让系统扫描一下，系统说是消肿的，
嘴巴肿了吗？
她掏出照妖镜左看看右看看，确实有点红，她挖了一点药膏涂抹在唇瓣上，惊讶地发现药膏落在嘴巴上竟然会泛起浅浅的红色，晶晶亮，宛若现代的唇釉，漂亮得要死。
啊啊啊，大师兄太棒了，这颜色和刚刚的红石榴榨汁似的，太好看了！
水润不显唇纹，透亮，晶莹，冰冰凉凉的还泛着淡淡的果香，她没忍住舔一口。
甜的。
舒晩昭连水果都不吃了，捧着药膏如获珍宝，眼睛晶晶亮，仿佛被投喂了罐罐的小猫咪，当场打呼噜的那一种。
楚桑榆一进来，看见的就是这一幕。
他午夜梦回的臭丫头，香喷喷地半躺在软榻上，黑红色的衣裙层层叠叠花朵般绽放，那张明媚的小脸此时洋溢着高兴的笑，手里不知道捧着什么，看样子很喜欢。
她就这样半躺，落入他的眼睛中，就是一幅精美的仕女图，周围的景色都成为了陪衬。
“臭……”丫头。
他情不自禁地靠近，没有注意到脚下的树枝，发出咔嚓的一声，他一惊，立即转过身体试图弄一个很帅的背影，当笨丫头看过来后，就会被他迷倒。
殊不知他这细微的动静，成功把某只沉迷于自己“口红”的猫猫职业病搞出来了。
她吓到竖起，还以为是有人趁着她溜号溜进来了，条件反射掏出她的三叉戟，看也没看一眼来人就叉了过去。

对面的楚桑榆：“？？？”
这些年他忙于掌管聚宝阁，根本没有太多时间修炼，修为被原本和他所差无几的谢寒声甩在了身后，更赶不上本来就比他修为高的大师兄。
他目前的修为只有大乘期后期，舒晩昭的法器大乘期之下无敌手，随便叉。
可是对于大乘期来说也会有点作用，加上他一来就被“美色”迷惑，一点抵抗的意思都没有，全靠肉身硬抗。
以至于，发生悲剧。
舒晩昭一叉子将他叉了个底朝天，他捂着老腰趴在地上，身上破破烂烂地哼哼唧唧地咆哮，“死丫头，你下死手啊。”
舒晩昭听到熟悉的声音一愣，疑惑的小眼神飘过去，落在他身上之后，眼神转为心虚。
她讲三叉戟背过身后，无辜脸，“哎呀，这不是那个谁吗？那个谁……就是那个谁嘛~”
楚桑榆：“……”
气死他了。
他原以为这些年自己的性格在聚宝阁中磨炼已经很沉稳了，未曾想，碰见这死丫头，立即让他回到百年前。
这该死的，臭丫头还有返老还童的作用呢？
少年气咻咻地从地上爬起来，结果后腰一凉，一回头，腰间的布料华丽丽地落下，他眼前一黑，捂着后腰转过身，“死丫头，怎么总往我腰上使劲儿。”
舒晩昭合理怀疑他是碰瓷，谁家好人看见有人攻击自己第一反应是背过身体啊。
更离谱的是，腰受了伤和被非礼似的，慌乱地抱着“胸”转过身对着她。
好了，那精壮的蜂腰，宽阔的后背，以及那精心养护的肌肤纹理，该看的不该看的舒晩昭都被“强迫”看了个一干二净。
content_en:
There are places where fighting is about to break out, and there are places where people are enjoying themselves.
Shu Minzhao waited at the entrance for a long time, and continued her afternoon tea without waiting for outsiders.
Anyway, with the eldest brother here, and the eldest brother is so powerful, the three men should be fine together.
【……】
It would be great if the last period of my life were so pleasant every day.
It’s the elder brother who is attentive and understands her.
She ate the sweet fruit in her mouth, looking up at the lush trees. The air was also very fresh, mixed with the smell of her senior brother's herbs just now. She just found a small bottle next to the senior brother's fruit plate, opened it and let the system scan it. The system said it was swelling.
Is your mouth swollen?
She took out the mirror and looked left and right, and it was indeed a little red. She took a little ointment and applied it on her lips. She was surprised to find that when the ointment fell on her mouth, it would turn a light red color, which was sparkling and bright, just like a modern lip gloss. It was so beautiful.
Ah ah ah, senior brother is great. The color is like the red pomegranate juice just made. It’s so pretty!
It was hydrating and didn't show any lip lines, it was translucent and crystal-clear, it was cold and had a light fruity fragrance, and she couldn't help but take a lick.
Sweet.
Shu Mingzhao didn't even eat the fruit. He was holding the ointment as if he had found a treasure. His eyes were bright, as if a kitten was fed in jars and snored on the spot.
When Chu Sangyu came in, this was what he saw.
The smelly girl from his midnight dream was half-lying on the soft couch with a sweet smell, her black and red dress blooming like flowers in layers, her bright little face was filled with a happy smile, and she was holding something in her hands, and she seemed to like it very much.
She lay half-lying like this, and fell into his eyes, just like a beautiful picture of a lady, with the surrounding scenery as a backdrop.
"Stinky..." Girl.
He couldn't help but get closer, not noticing that the branches under his feet made a clicking sound. He was startled, and immediately turned around to try to make a handsome figure from behind. When the stupid girl looked over, she would be fascinated by him.
Little did he know that his subtle movement had successfully caused an occupational disease in a cat who was addicted to his "lipstick".
She stood up in fear, thinking that someone had sneaked in while she was there, so she reflexively took out her trident and thrust it at the person without even looking at the person.
Chu Sangyu on the opposite side: "???"
Over the years, he has been busy in charge of Jubao Pavilion and has not had much time to practice. His cultivation level was left behind by Xie Hansheng, who was almost the same as him, and he could not keep up with his senior brother who was already higher than him.
His current cultivation level is only in the late Mahayana stage. Shu Mizhao's magical weapon is invincible under the Mahayana stage and can be used at will.
But it will also have some effect on the Mahayana stage. In addition, he was confused by the "beauty" as soon as he came, and had no intention of resisting at all. He relied entirely on his physical body to resist.
As a result, tragedy occurred.
Shu Minzhao thrust him upside down with a fork, and he lay on the ground clutching his waist, his body in tatters and growling, "You damn girl, you're so cruel."
Shu Zhaozhao was startled when he heard the familiar voice, and his doubtful eyes drifted over. After landing on him, his eyes turned guilty.
She turned the trident behind her back with an innocent face, "Oh, isn't this that person? That person... is that person~"
Chu Sangyu: "..."
He was so angry.
He originally thought that his character had become very stable after being tempered in the Treasure Pavilion over the years. He never thought that meeting this dead girl would immediately take him back to a hundred years ago.
Damn it, does the smelly girl have the effect of rejuvenating?
The young man got up from the ground angrily. As a result, his lower back felt cold. When he turned around, the fabric around his waist fell down gorgeously. His vision went dark. He covered his lower back and turned around, "Damn girl, why are you always pushing so hard on my waist?"
Shu Mingzhao reasonably suspected that he was trying to get someone to attack him. The first reaction of any good person when he saw someone attacking him was to turn his back.
What’s even more outrageous is that his waist was injured andAs if being molested, he hugged his "breasts" in a panic and turned to face her.
Well, Shu Mizhao was "forced" to look at the strong waist, the broad back, and the carefully maintained skin texture, what should be seen and what should not be seen.
